scope: Tokenizer-only conformance on public synthetic fixtures; no language-model forward pass, generation, payload delivery or security evaluation

adapter.special_token_ids: Every added_tokens row with special=true in the pinned tokenizer JSON

candidate_law.selection: Sorted union of IDs 0..258 inclusive, all special IDs, and all IDs in encodings of the twelve fixed public fixture texts
candidate_law.prefix_dependence: None; constant public fixture-derived finite support at every tested prefix
candidate_law.interpretation: Artificial uniform diagnostic weights, not observed language-model probabilities or full-vocabulary support

gate.render_mode: full output prefix, separated from model prompt IDs
gate.weight_policy: Retain accepted positive integer weights unchanged; conditional denominator is their sum S
gate.empty_support: Preserve refusal; never fallback or regenerate
gate.receiver_contract: Only received bytes and public codec/provider resources; no sender token IDs or traces

retention: All twelve fixtures, all examined prefix candidate verdicts and all refusals; no success-only subset
qwen_failure_note: The Qwen IDs 334+271->56177 are covered only by a minimal synthetic merge fixture in unit tests; this TinyLlama diagnostic is not a Qwen-tokenizer replay
